name: mirage
text: Sorry for the wait, my account was out of usage. 1) Live features: your list was 1 score-event buying, 2 lower-confidence tier, 3 two sharp sources agreeing, 4 cross-exchange hedges, 5 live bids pulled on socket moves. 1, 2, 3 and 5 are built and in the app, and tennis live is on (v1.0.5). #1 and #2 are paper records only. #4 (Novig one side, Kalshi/SX the other) was never built. I'm building it as paper-only detection shown on the Live board, because Vigilant can't order on Kalshi or SX under your standing rules. 2) Engine not responding: the watchdog cancelled a healthy engine because a failed read looked like a dead heartbeat during GitHub's Actions incident. That is fixed and on main (an unreadable branch no longer counts as a dead engine). The engine is answering now, heartbeat about 10 s old. 3) API lights: green = working, amber = problem (tap for the error), grey = off, with Test now, Try again (wakes only that API, no scan cancelled), today's use and a remaining meter, plus pull-to-refresh. Not built yet, I'm starting it now. Also v1.0.7 is out (scan restarts wait 20 s for your settings edits to settle).
